name: syrius-agent
description: Syrius Agent - Autonomous Instagram & Social Media Growth Engine with Gemini 2.5 & Recraft v3

scripts.dev:classic: concurrently -k -n "DESKTOP_UI,ELECTRON,EXPO_MOBILE" -c "cyan,blue,magenta" "npm run dev:renderer" "npm run dev:electron" "npm run dev:mobile"
scripts.build:electron: tsc -p tsconfig.electron.json && copy /Y electron\package.json dist-electron\package.json && copy /Y electron\preload.cjs dist-electron\electron\preload.cjs && if not exist dist-electron\assets mkdir dist-electron\assets && copy /Y electron\assets\*.* dist-electron\assets\ && if not exist dist-electron\electron mkdir dist-electron\electron && if not exist dist-electron\electron\assets mkdir dist-electron\electron\assets && copy /Y electron\assets\*.* dist-electron\electron\assets\
scripts.build: npm run build:renderer && npm run build:electron
